name: Async catch linkage requires suspended re-raise support

input.source_text: class E { }; module M { public fun run() -> Object { let obj = E.new(); try { try { raise obj } catch e { raise } } catch e2, c { [e2 same? obj, c.value same? obj, c.cause] } } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Exception context identity has no native boundary.
